name: ${package_name}
//types: Correct as written, do not 'fix' it: typesVersions below is applied to the types field too, so "index.d.ts" resolves to lib/esm/index.d.ts. Writing that literal path applies the mapping twice (lib/esm/lib/esm/index.d.ts) and breaks node10 resolution. Verify with ts.resolveModuleName under node10 AND bundler, not by looking for the file on disk.

scripts.build: rimraf ./lib && npm run build-esm && npm run build-cjs && npm run copy-to-lib && npm run dual-package
scripts.copy-to-lib: echo 'copying CSS + JSON assets to lib folder' && copyfiles -u 1 'src/**/*.css' 'src/**/*.json' lib/esm && copyfiles -u 1 'src/**/*.css' 'src/**/*.json' lib/cjs
scripts.dual-package: echo 'adding package.json to each lib folder for dual output support' && tsconfig-to-dual-package ./tsconfig-cjs.json ./tsconfig-esm.json
